passages.title: My Little Cottage
passages.text: Hi! I am Rosie. I live in a small cottage in the meadow. My house has a red door and two windows. I have a cat. Her name is Button. She is white and very small. Every morning, Button sleeps in the sun.

questions.explain: 'I have a cat. Her name is Button.'

questions.q: Where does Button sleep in the morning?
questions.explain: 'Every morning, Button sleeps in the sun.'

passages.title: A Note for Mum
passages.text: Dear Mum, I am at Ben's house. We are playing games. I will be home at six o'clock. Please don't make pasta for me — Ben's mum has pizza for us! Love, Sam

questions.explain: 'I will be home at six o'clock.'
Ben's mum has pizza for them.

passages.title: Meadow Pet Shop
passages.text: Meadow Pet Shop. Open Monday to Saturday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Closed on Sunday. Today: rabbit food is half price! Small fish: £3 each.

questions.q: How much is a small fish?

passages.title: Tom's Day
passages.text: Tom gets up at seven o'clock. He eats eggs and drinks orange juice. He goes to school by bus. After school, he plays football with his friends. In the evening, he reads a book and goes to bed at nine.

questions.q: How does Tom go to school?
When does Tom go to bed?

passages.title: A Postcard
passages.text: Hello Grandma! We are at the beach. The weather is hot and sunny. I swim in the sea every day. My sister likes making sandcastles. The food is good, but the hotel is very small. See you on Friday! Love, Mia
